# Furkan Vijapura

> Senior Mobile Engineer based in India, working across native iOS, cross-platform
> Flutter, and serverless mobile backends. Over nine years of professional mobile development
> since January 2017 across five companies, currently Senior Mobile Developer at Wve Labs since
> July 2021. Ships native iOS (Swift, SwiftUI, SwiftData) and cross-platform Flutter apps on
> serverless backends (Firebase, AWS Amplify), and has recently added AI and agentic tooling such
> as Claude Code, MCP server integration, and GitHub Actions automation to his mobile engineering
> workflow.

## Verified facts

- Experience: January 2017 to present (9+ years), across AGILE Infoways, Discus Business
  Solutions, WeblineIndia, Ciright Inc., and Wve Labs (current, Senior Mobile Developer, since
  July 2021).
- Live App Store products from the Wve Labs era:
  - The Daily Pour (formerly Bottle Raiders): an AI spirits review app that scans bottle labels
    and barcodes. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-daily-pour/id6502606142
  - Ovvy: Real Estate Camera, an AI real estate photography platform built by Wve Labs.
    https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ovvy-real-estate-camera/id6447063745
  - Puff Count: Quit Vaping Now, a vaping cessation app used by hundreds of thousands.
    https://apps.apple.com/us/app/puff-count-quit-vaping-now/id1488580640
  - The NotME App, a consent verification app.
    https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-notme-app/id6745784550
- Certifications: Anthropic "Claude Code in Action" (March 2026), Udemy SwiftUI (2025), Coursera
  "iOS App Store & In-App Purchases" (2021), Coursera "Programming in Swift 5" (2021), Udemy
  "Flutter & Dart" (2020), Udemy "Swift and Xcode Development" (2020), Google Digital Unlocked,
  IICT certification.
- Education: MCA, Suresh Gyan Vihar University (2020 to 2022); Master of Mobile Application
  Development, Ganpat University (2016 to 2018); BCA, Grow More Group of Institutions (2013 to
  2016).
